description.value: A sushi restaurant on Denman Street in Vancouver's West End, steps from the Stanley Park seawall cycling routes. The menu spans bento boxes, nigiri, sashimi, specialty rolls, donburi, and party trays, making it a flexible stop for solo riders or groups. Online ordering with pick-up is available, convenient for cyclists who want to grab food without waiting.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces, covered) at 23m; stands (3 spaces) at 26m; stands (2 spaces) at 27m; stands (4 spaces) at 27m; stands (6 spaces, covered) at 36m; stands (6 spaces) at 73m. Total: 23 spaces.

The website's active online ordering system with a pick-up option confirms the restaurant is operational; the 'Closed' label on the website reflects a current-hours status, not permanent closure, consistent with OSM's looks_closed=false.
